tooltip.ars_misc.critical_belt: Belt slot: +50 percentage points of spell critical chance.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_belt.regenerat: Successful spell critical hits grant Mana Regeneration II for 10 seconds.
tooltip.ars_misc.mining_blasting_2: Adds Amplify x2, AOE x2 and Pierce x2 to Break.
tooltip.ars_misc.mining_blasting_1: Adds Amplify x1 and AOE x2 to Break.
tooltip.ars_misc.decay_ring: Ring: spell damage applies Decay for 30s; healing becomes equal magic damage, subject to defenses and invulnerability.
ars_misc.glyph_life_sense.desc: Grants Life Sense for 60 seconds, revealing living creatures within 75 blocks through walls to the recipient. Only loaded and tracked entities are shown. Supports Extend Time and Duration Down.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_life_sense: Grants Life Sense for 60 seconds, revealing living creatures within 75 blocks through walls to the recipient. Only loaded and tracked entities are shown. Supports Extend Time and Duration Down.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_regeneration: Grants vanilla Regeneration I for 10s. Each Amplify adds one level, up to V with four Amplifies. Supports Extend Time and Duration Down; Decay reverses its healing.
ars_misc.glyph_desc.glyph_sacrificial_sh: The caster pays 2 real health to grant Absorption II for 60s. Each Amplify adds two levels and costs 2 more health, up to X with four Amplifies. Recasting replaces and refills Absorption. The health cost can kill and can trigger a held vanilla Totem. Extend Time adds 15s without increasing the health cost.
death.attack.ars_misc.sacrifice: %1$s sacrificed their life for a shield
item.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket_watch.he: Scribe like an Enchanter's Mirror. Right-click to configure; casts periodically while equipped.
item.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket_watch.er: Pocket watch paused after a spell error. See the log.
documentation.ars_misc.enchanters_pocket: The Enchanter's Pocket Watch is a curio that stores a Self spell and casts it automatically at the configured interval while equipped.

Scribe a spell without a cast form at a Scribe's Table, as with an Enchanter's Mirror; the watch inserts Self automatically. Right-click it to choose an interval from 5 to 3,600 seconds or pause it. It works only in a curio slot, spends the player's normal spell mana, and does not queue failed casts.
gui.ars_misc.watch.scribe: Scribe an effect sequence at the Scribe's Table. Self is added automatically.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_necklace: Necklace slot: +100 percentage points of spell critical damage bonus.
tooltip.ars_misc.critical_necklace.damag: Successful spell critical hits grant Spell Damage II for 10 seconds; subsequent critical hits refresh it.
